name: Nebius Group N.V.
blurb: Nebius Group is the Amsterdam-headquartered successor entity to Yandex's international operations after the Russian tech giant divested all domestic assets to a Russian consortium in a $5.4 billion transaction completed in July 2024. Led by Yandex co-founder Arkady Volozh, the renamed company has repositioned itself as a full-stack GPU cloud — a so-called neocloud — offering compute infrastructure for training and running large AI models. The Yandex engineering lineage gives it unusual depth in distributed systems and large-scale model serving.
recent: Nebius resumed NASDAQ trading under ticker NBIS in October 2024 (formerly YNDX). Revenue for fiscal 2025 came in at $529.8 million, up roughly 479% year-over-year. Management guided to $3.0-3.4 billion in 2026 revenue. A reported $2.7 billion infrastructure deal with Meta in early 2026 would represent a step-function expansion of its client base.
